notes:
### New Features
- **Android build** - First Android APK ships with this release: local library and playback, without the YouTube integration and auto-updates for now
- **Navidrome support** - Connect your Navidrome server in settings: browse its artists, albums and playlists, search and stream with covers and metadata
- **Download manager** - Persistent download queue with progress, retries and cancel; grab single tracks, whole albums or playlists for offline playback
- **Downloads panel** - Download indicator in the header with a queue panel, active batches also show in storage settings
- **Listening stats page** - Stats moved into their own settings tab: summary, streaks with a calendar heatmap, top tracks, artists and genres, records, hourly activity and completion, switchable periods and history clearing
- **Track editor v2** - Rebuilt edit form with artist and album pickers, creating an album by title, track and disc numbers, and an unsaved-changes guard
- **YouTube links in search** - Paste a YouTube or YT Music link to open the playlist, album, channel or video directly instead of text-searching the URL
- **YouTube library import** - Downloaded YT tracks and albums land as real library entries with artwork and resolved artists
- **Source switcher** - Catalog pages switch between the local library and connected sources from a dropdown
- **Queue drag rework** - Reordering runs on vue-dnd-kit with animated row moves and a drag preview locked to the vertical axis
- **Compact sidebar extras** - Entity tooltips on the covers-only rail, a playing indicator, folder item counts and blur-up covers for remote items

### Improvements
- Next-track prefetch watches the queue and repeat mode directly, so it warms YouTube and Navidrome streams after reorders, mode changes and app restarts
- Icon transitions (play/pause, update button, source switcher) moved from flubber to morphicons
- Context and dropdown menus close when the cursor leaves them; track menus group secondary actions under a More submenu
- Artist and album matching during import is case-insensitive and language-aware, so imports link to existing entries instead of creating duplicates
- Import runs are serialized behind a single queue, and destructive multi-table cascades run in one transaction
- A wedged yt-dlp resolve times out, cancel kills the whole process tree, and transient download failures retry up to three times
- Empty states share one set of components; toasts got a glass background
- Clearing all data asks for confirmation with a delayed destructive button
- Scrollable areas lock while an overlay is open instead of scrolling underneath it

### Bug Fixes
- Shadow rows from remote sources no longer leak into library lists and search
- Editing or liking a track updates stats top lists and history right away
- Chapters can no longer be attached to non-library tracks, and a migration cleans up stray rows
- Stats bucket days by local midnight, so the heatmap and periods match your timezone
- Concurrent playlist cascade writes no longer clobber each other
- Pinning a remote track no longer fails with DataCloneError
- Covers show up on artist-page album cards and refresh on current-track surfaces
- Right-clicking catalog rows opens a proper menu instead of an empty popup
